topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Oh my god, I can't believe the building's going condo. I mean, I saw it coming, kind of, but I didn't think it'd hit so soon. I should've said something, tried to rally the neighbors, done more. Now everyone's in an uproar, and it’s just chaos. I keep thinking, if I’d spoken up earlier, maybe we could've found a way to stop it or at least prepare. I feel so bad for you, having to deal with all this. You’ve got enough on your plate already. I wish I could just take it all away. Let's talk about this, okay? Maybe we can still find a way through this mess.
